content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy provides a straightforward platform for selling digital products, but its service is inaccessible for many creators in restricted countries. Stripe and PayPal offer payment processing but notoriously limit access based on geography, leaving many without reliable options. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, such as COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack, enables creators to build their own stores with full ownership and control, ensuring they can sell digital products directly without reliance on restrictive platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal impose severe geographical restrictions, effectively locking out creators in numerous countries. This has led to lost opportunities and unrealized potential for countless digital creators. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed without these limitations, allowing creators from any location to establish a fully operational online store. This means creators can sell without fear of being excluded or subject to arbitrary restrictions based on their nationality.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment processors like PayPal may take up to 180 days to release funds after an account suspension, causing significant cash flow issues. Stripe charges transaction fees but offers no service in many regions. Sovereign commerce solutions like COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack utilize NOWPayments, which has a low 0.5% fee and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This allows creators to receive payments instantly without the delays and risks associated with traditional platforms, ensuring they maintain liquidity.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure empowers you with full ownership of your digital storefront.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Traditional platforms often retain control over customer data and sales, which can be detrimental to creators. When using Lemon Squeezy or similar services, creators typically do not own the underlying infrastructure. In contrast, with COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack, creators own everything after deployment, ensuring they have full control over their customer interactions and data. The automation of payment processing and instant file delivery means creators can focus on their craft instead of administrative headaches.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs as a creator. If you have limited technical skills, a simpler setup like the Sovereign Starter Stack might be ideal. However, if you require comprehensive tools and scalability, the Edge Commerce Stack offers advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing, ensuring a robust and secure online store. Assess your current and future needs to select the solution that will best support your growth.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Avoid the risks of account suspensions and fund holds with traditional payment processors.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
